dedupe_keys.name: cyprus department of meteorology station network map and climatological information

description: The Cyprus Department of Meteorology, which provides weather and climate information to all sectors of economic and social activity, publishes climatological information and a map of its station network. The climatological information page links an agrometeorological bulletin, a drought index (the standardised precipitation index, SPI), a seasonal forecast for the next three months, daily temperature and rainfall data, a list of meteorological notes and studies, a medium-range outlook from the WMO Climate Watch Advisory Group, a monthly weather bulletin, and preliminary and final rainfall data. The station network map, published on the national open data portal as a shapefile under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence, shows all meteorological stations in Cyprus with each station's number, elevation and type; it was released in 2018 and last modified in November 2025. Access is free online. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): CC-BY-4.0. Coverage is Cyprus. It supports hazard exposure and climate adaptation analysis of drought, heat and heavy rainfall for water, energy and transport infrastructure; related records are the IMN Costa Rica climate atlas and stations and the Cyprus forest fire catalogue.
